instruction: Split the employee data in column A into First Name, Last Name, and Rank columns. In cell E1, add a label, and in E2, enter the count of C-level executives (CEO, CFO, CTO).

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully split mixed employee data (FirstName LastName Rank) from column A into separate First Name (B), Last Name (C), and Rank (D) columns using formulas in LibreOffice Calc. Completed in 20 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc cells, enter formulas for text splitting (LEFT, MID, RIGHT, FIND), copy formulas down columns, handle multi-word parsing
metadata.explanation: Extends the text-splitting task by requiring a COUNTIF-style analysis of C-level titles. Getter reads D column (ranks) and E1/E2 cells; metric checks label exists, ranks populated, and count is correct.
metadata.task_rationale: Model proved it can split text. This variation adds a COUNTIF aggregation step requiring conditional counting of C-level roles.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric correctly handles expected parameter: expected.get('expected_count', 3) directly accesses the rules dict as expected when type='rule'.
Getter correctly extracts E1 (label), E2 (count), and D column (ranks) from the xlsx file.
Postconfig properly saves the file with Ctrl+S before getter reads it.
Partial credit scoring (0.3 label + 0.3 ranks + 0.4 count) is reasonable and well-structured.

COVERAGE GAP: Instruction requires splitting into First Name (B), Last Name (C), and Rank (D) columns, but evaluator only verifies column D (Rank). Columns B and C are never checked. A correct Rank column is a weak proxy for the full split but not a guarantee.
Rank threshold of non_null_ranks >= 20 is hardcoded; if the actual data has fewer than 20 employees, this check would incorrectly fail.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter extraction for columns B (First Name) and C (Last Name) to verify the full split, not just the Rank column.
Add a scoring component (e.g., 0.1-0.2) for checking that First Name and Last Name columns are populated, reducing weight on other components accordingly.
Consider making the rank threshold dynamic based on actual data row count instead of hardcoding >= 20.
